description: The trails starts at an elevation of +/- 539 meters and winds its way up the mountian and along a ridge with views of the Christina Lake up to an elevation of +/- 1159 meters.
directions: From Christina Lake BC turn onto West Lake Drive heading in a northerly direction for +/- 1.7 km and then turn onto Chase Road for +/- 1.5 km and onto Highland Road for +/- 150 meters.
title: Boris Wheeler
